review_scope: All 49 full-frame and fixed initial-site tiles; comparison against original clip, native empty reference and real continuation.
duplicate_removal_criterion: No stationary original cup body, printed motif or rim at the source site in frames 4..48 (0.5..6.0s). Initial frame contains the original cup as intended.
initial_cup_site: Cup recognizable in frames 0..1. Residual fade/outline in frames 2..3. Empty wall/floor/table region in frames 4..48; no persistent cup or old rim.
transition_limitation: Brief duplicate/fade in the initial 0.125..0.375s; this is not a perfect instantaneous physical transfer.
moving_foreground: Blue shape follows the coarse upward robot-arm control response, partly leaves the frame near 1s, then appears as a distorted narrow fragment near the arm. It remains in the clip; cartoon identity is not reliably retained.
image_quality: Room, robot, table and brown cup remain recognizable. Local empty site has softer reconstructed detail and a small generated boundary near the gripper; no residual cup shell after 0.5s.
temporal_consistency: Background largely stable; early source-site fade and moving shape deformation remain. Held control after 2s does not prove six-second forecast realism.
trajectory_and_identity: Persistent duplicate removal passes. Correct robot interaction, preservation of physical cup identity and agreement with real future do not pass; use visibility-qualified proxy metrics, not identity-certified trajectories.
manual_gate: PASS for persistent duplicate removal after 0.5s; remaining transition/identity/physics limits explicitly retained.
